title: Pixel Buds Pro 2 And 2a Are Getting Some Upgrades, Including Deeper Gemini Integration
excerpt: Google didn't have any new headphones this year, but some new features are coming to the Pixel Buds.
content_html:
However, the company did not show off any new designs at today's Made by Google event.

Today was a big day for Google. The company showed off gobs of new Pixel products, including phones, foldables, watches and Bluetooth trackers. However, there were no new earbuds. The Pixel Buds Pro 2 and Pixel Buds 2a are still the latest earbuds in the company's roster, even though the Pro 2 earbuds are two years old and the 2a earbuds are almost a year old.

However, Google did just share some software updates coming to the company's line of earbuds. The Pixel Buds Pro 2 earbuds are getting dynamic ANC, which will "adjust to compensate when subtle shifts in the seal happen." This is actually pretty neat, as we all know how finicky those earbud seals can get.

Both models are also getting deeper Gemini integration, as the chatbot will be able to adjust the volume and make EQ changes on command. Google has announced that the earbuds will be able to sync with the Pixel Watch, which automatically pauses the music when the watch senses someone has fallen asleep. This will also automatically disable notifications.

The live translate feature has been upgraded for use with the earbuds and can now understand and translate over 70 languages. Users just have to tap the earbuds to trigger listening mode and let the algorithm do the rest.

Finally, the Pixel Buds Pro 2 earbuds are getting a new color. There's an olive-green finish coming down the pike, and preorders are open right now. The software updates are coming in September.

For the uninitiated, the Pixel Buds Pro 2 are Google's high-end earbuds and the 2a are the company's budget-friendly earbuds. We came away impressed with both designs.

content_html_zh:
不过，该公司并未在今天的 Made by Google 活动上展示任何新设计。

今天对于谷歌来说是一个重要的日子。 该公司展示了一系列新的 Pixel 产品，包括手机、可折叠设备、手表和蓝牙跟踪器。 然而，没有新的耳塞。 Pixel Buds Pro 2 和 Pixel Buds 2a 仍然是该公司名册中最新的耳机，尽管 Pro 2 耳机已经推出两年了，2a 耳机也已经推出了近一年。

然而，谷歌确实分享了该公司耳机系列的一些软件更新。 Pixel Buds Pro 2 耳机采用了动态 ANC，它将“在密封发生细微变化时进行调整以进行补偿”。 这实际上非常简洁，因为我们都知道这些耳塞密封件有多挑剔。

两种型号也都得到了更深入的 Gemini 集成，因为聊天机器人将能够根据命令调整音量并更改 EQ。 谷歌宣布这款耳机将能够与 Pixel Watch 同步，当手表检测到有人睡着时，它会自动暂停音乐。 这也将自动禁用通知。

实时翻译功能已升级，可与耳塞配合使用，现在可以理解和翻译 70 多种语言。 用户只需点击耳塞即可触发聆听模式，然后让算法完成剩下的工作。

最后，Pixel Buds Pro 2 耳机有了新的颜色。 即将推出橄榄绿饰面，现已开放预订。 软件更新将于 9 月推出。

对于外行来说，Pixel Buds Pro 2 是 Google 的高端耳机，2a 是该公司的经济型耳机。 这两种设计都给我们留下了深刻的印象。
